author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description:
Jerome Powell’s term as chair of the Federal Reserve ends Friday, May 15. If President Donald Trump had had his way, Powell’s time at the helm of the country’s central bank would’ve come to a close far sooner.

Watch an excerpt from "The President vs. the Fed" that goes inside President Trump's unprecedented effort to assert control over the most powerful institution in the U.S. economy.   

The full documentary premieres May 12, 2026 on @frontline.

https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/frontline/documentary/the-president-vs-the-fed/

“The President vs. the Fed” is a FRONTLINE production with Left/Right Docs. The director and correspondent is James Jacoby. The producers and writers are Anya Bourg and James Jacoby. The senior producer is Frank Koughan.
title: Inside Trump's Unprecedented Pressure Campaign on the Fed and Jerome Powell | FRONTLINE
